name: Dr Alexander Mikhalev
role: Managing Partner, CTO and Head of AI, Zestic AI
tagline: Managing Partner and CTO building applied AI and autonomous delivery systems
bio: I combine technology direction with hands-on Rust, Python and TypeScript engineering. As an inspiring technical leader, I build teams and strengthen performance, resilience, compliance and security. I lead the Terraphim AI privacy-preserving ecosystem and autonomous delivery infrastructure, alongside client architecture at Zestic AI. My experience includes enterprise architecture and the Synthetic Data Platform at Nationwide, industrial AI leadership at Klarian, startup team building at Shopitize and applied research at Cranfield. I am the author of Context Engineering: Designing AI That Understands, Remembers, Acts and Learns (2026).

education.course: MSc (Engineer) in Information Systems and Computer Science
education.institution: Moscow State Technical University n/a Bauman (MSTU), Russia
